karachi.title: Consulate of Italy — Karachi (Sindh & Balochistan)
karachi.note: For residents of Sindh and Balochistan: documents attested by MOFA must be translated into Italian by authorised translators of the Embassy / Consulate of Italy in Karachi. Translated documents must then be legalised by the competent Embassy or Consulate. Submit visa requests at BLS Karachi and Quetta. Apply at least 15 days before departure — shorter timelines are not possible for technical reasons.
